reviews.text:
I wholeheartedly recommend this person! She looked after my dog ​​for a week and, as always, everything went perfectly. She is very professional, reliable, caring, and above all, passionate about animals.

I use her services every year because she's the only person I can trust to look after my dog. I know he's in very good hands, which allows me to travel with complete peace of mind.

A huge thank you for your kindness, professionalism, and all the care you gave my dog. I 100% recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable and trustworthy person to care for their four-legged friend! 🐶

Maria looked after my dog ​​while I was on vacation, and I found him so happy and fulfilled! The stay at her home went very well, as did the days at Dog Paradise. She pays particular attention to my dog, who is reactive towards other dogs. The work we do, thanks to her advice and classes, allows us to see significant improvements, and the days at Dog Paradise are incredibly beneficial for him. Maria is very dedicated; thanks to her, my dog ​​is learning to better manage his emotions!
Maria's dog daycare is fantastic! The dog always comes back very happy and loves to return. Highly recommended! And the paradise is amazing! Plus, the behavior sessions are excellent.

We took training classes with Maria for Tihya, our soon-to-be one-year-old Staffordshire Bull Terrier. Maria has known Tihya since she was a puppy through the Dog Paradise center and was able to help us channel her boundless energy! I highly recommend Maria for her kind and attentive training sessions. 😊

Perfect, I highly recommend it 😊
My dog ​​had a wonderful stay despite her occasional anxiety.
Thanks again!

Since moving from Canada with our 6-year-old Shepherd cross, Quincey, we wanted to find a trusted dog boarding and daycare, and we're so happy we found Maria! She is professional, reliable, and gives us real peace of mind when we travel, knowing Quincey is so well cared for. We also love the little videos she posts on Instagram to check in on her.
Quincey especially enjoys the weekly getaways to Dog Paradis. With so few big dog parks in the city, it's wonderful that she gets lots of space to run and socialize with other dogs.
We also worked with Maria on training for leash pulling and managing excitement, and Quincey has improved so much in such a short time.
We could not recommend Maria more!

Maria looks after our dog while we're on vacation and can't take her with us. Plume always comes back very calm and composed from her stays with Maria, which is proof to me that she has a wonderful time. The days at Dog Paradise are a real bonus for a dynamic dog like mine. I leave with complete peace of mind, knowing my dog ​​is in the care of such a professional team. A big thank you to Maria!

We've used Maria's services several times for day or weekend pet sitting. Everything went very well, and the added bonus is that we get regular updates through her Instagram stories! Our Walter and we thank her 🐶 …

I'm delighted with Maria's care for my young dog. She has extensive experience with large breeds and knows how to provide them with the care, respect, and affection they need for their well-being. Punctual and responsible, she and her partner constantly watch over the dogs. They enjoy interacting with other dogs, including her own, who is very sociable. My dog ​​even learned to walk on a leash from her, which is a real bonus! For the safety and development he experienced, I highly recommend Maria.

I have a very energetic dog that we had trouble managing – Maria helped us a lot with our training methods so that the process would progress in the right direction – I highly recommend her for training and pet sitting – Maria is extremely kind to our four-legged friends

We entrusted Ulia to Maria's care during our vacation and we are absolutely delighted!
Walks, cuddles, and plenty of attention were all part of the experience. In addition to enjoying every comfort at Maria's home, Ulia spent three days a week at Dog Paradise.
We've seen wonderful progress, especially in his socialization with other dogs. We're so pleased that we're considering taking classes with Maria to further develop Ulia's skills.

I left my two dogs with Maria over the Christmas holidays, and everything went very well. They even got a little Christmas meal! 😄
They have very different personalities, and they both adore Maria.
On a personal level, communication is always smooth, and Maria is very friendly.
I highly recommend her!

I had three dog training sessions with Maria for my puppy Aspen, and everything went perfectly. She gives excellent advice, always with a gentle and positive attitude. Thanks to her, Aspen has already made great progress.

I also use Maria for occasional dog sitting, and I leave my dog ​​with her without hesitation: she is reliable, caring, and truly passionate about animals.
I highly recommend her! 🌟🐾

L'Âne Rouge is a warm and welcoming place, perfect for spending quality time with friends or family. The atmosphere is pleasant, the decor charming, and the service friendly. The food and drinks are delicious, and everything is done to ensure a pleasant experience 🍽️🥂

The only minor point for improvement might be the management of reservations during peak hours, but overall, it's a place I highly recommend. 👍

Maria is wonderful, and the progress I’ve seen in my dog since spending time with her has been incredible. He’s become so much more confident and social, and it’s clear how much he enjoys being with her. Every time he comes home, he’s happy, relaxed, and tired from a full day of fun and love. Maria understands dogs and cares for them as if they were her own. I’m so grateful for the impact she’s had on Rollo — I couldn’t recommend her more highly!

Maria is a fantastic dog sitter, gentle and attentive to the needs of her charges. Our dog Gus, who came from the shelter, trusts her completely. She taught him how to play with other dogs and understand canine etiquette. Gus is always happy to see Maria, and we can go on vacation with complete peace of mind, happy knowing he's with her. Maria is kind enough to regularly send us stories to keep us updated on our dog's days and evenings. In short, everyone is happy!

Maria is an amazing person and knowledgeable trainer who speaks French and English. She taught us how to help our dogs acclimate to city life and has improved the quality of life for our whole family. She loves and cares for our dogs and we are so grateful for her.

A wonderful experience with Maria! We left our dog with her for five days, and he had a fantastic holiday, meeting lots of new friends. Jean-Claude will be seeing his friends again at the end of September, and this is just the beginning. Thank you again for your professionalism.
I want to thank Maria so much; I'm extremely satisfied with everything she does for my dog. Maria is a fantastic canine behaviorist and very caring.

Thank you so much, Maria, for taking such good care of our little Snoopy, our intrepid and energetic beagle, during our vacation.

We left feeling completely at ease and confident. Throughout his stay, we followed his adventures with his doggy friends on Instagram Stories. We found him in great shape and well-rested!

He was able to fully enjoy Dog Paradise for that 🌈

I've entrusted my dog ​​to Maria twice already and I'm delighted with the experience! Dougie is always happy and excited to see her :) He'll definitely go back whenever we need someone to look after him!

Snowy, my 14-year-old Bichon Frise, has been looked after several times by Maria and her colleagues for weekends and holidays. I highly recommend them! In addition to being very kind and understanding, she adapted the activities to his age and sent me regular updates. Thank you again!

We entrusted our dog Napoleon to Maria for a week, and it was simply perfect! Between the Dog Paradise, the varied walks, and the quiet, cuddly moments, Napoleon had a dream vacation. You can tell that Maria deeply loves animals and that she takes care of them with attention and kindness.
Thanks to her, we were able to go on vacation with complete peace of mind, knowing he was in good hands. I highly recommend her and wouldn't hesitate for a second to use her services again. Thank you again, Maria!

Maria often looks after Uska, a little beagle whose trust she quickly gained. Available, reliable, and attentive, Maria takes excellent care of Uska. Sharing photos and videos lets us see Uska interacting with her friends, or simply relaxing in a cozy basket after a good play session. Maria gives us a debriefing every time we pick up Uska, which is always interesting. Entrusting your dog to Maria means a vacation for your dog and peace of mind for you :)

Maria is a fantastic dog sitter! My Jack means everything to me, and she knows how to take care of him. I feel completely confident leaving him with Maria! Plus, he has a wonderful time at Dog Paradise!

Maria has been regularly looking after our little beagle since she was 4 months old. She's a fantastic dog sitter! Noosa adores her and is thrilled every time she sees her! She's very gentle and has extensive experience with dogs! Noosa also enjoys playing with other dogs when she stays there, whether at Maria's or at Dog Paradise. I highly recommend her!

A very warm welcome; my dog ​​thoroughly enjoyed the cuddles and interactions with the other dogs. We received lots of photos and updates throughout her stay. I'm delighted. Thank you again for the excellent care! I highly recommend it!

Maria is a fantastic pet sitter. She always managed to find us a place, and her detailed messages explaining our dog's stay, successes, and challenges were incredibly helpful and reassuring afterward. Always cheerful and positive in her approach to our four-legged friends, I highly recommend her!

Maria is responsive, accommodating, very attentive, and full of helpful advice and knowledge that allowed us to understand our dog much better and quickly correct his aggressive behavior. Our dog has made great progress in just a few sessions. Thank you so much, Maria!
I know Maria through Dog Paradise. Baloo is always happy to see her every week! 😊 …

Maria has been looking after my little Vico, an 11-month-old dachshund, for a few months now.

I'm very happy with the services she provides.
Vico is always delighted to spend the days there; he plays with his friends and gets plenty of exercise.
Maria has experience and expertise with animals, and I highly recommend her.
Thanks again for everything you do for Vico! 😀
A very good experience for our dog at Maria's; excellent care, good advice, and a happy dog ​​every time.

Maria is a fantastic caregiver! My dog ​​Pacha has improved so much in her behavior and is better at managing her emotions. I'm so happy I found a caregiver like Maria; I feel completely at ease when I leave her with her. Dog Paradise is also a great place where Pacha can enjoy spending time with her friends!
I highly recommend Maria!
